sources.name: Wikidata (names, dates of birth, playing positions)

caveats: Statistics cover only matches in Cricsheet's ball-by-ball archive (ODI from 2002, Tests from 2001, T20I from 2005), so long careers are partial.
Cricsheet withholds matches involving Afghanistan men; Afghanistan players are therefore missing or under-represented.
Only full-member nations are included; associate-nation T20Is are excluded.
Ratings and base prices are calculated by this game, not official.
Bowling type for some non-IPL players is estimated from new-ball usage.
